sections.title: Synopsis
sections.markdown: Freeze damage support based on shield generation and Freeze damage amplification based on shield size. Capable of multiple Interceptions per turn and can generate Confectance Index for Freeze-attributed allies.

sections.title: Team notes
sections.markdown: Significantly enhances Freeze-attributed allies through damage boost as well as critical damage (V3+) and applying an increased Freeze damage taken debuff. At V2+, can generate an extra point of Confectance Index for Freeze allies, potentially altering skill rotations. High synergy with Robella - Alva can perform multiple interceptions per turn and can hit a large AoE with her S2, tagging targets for Robella's follow-ups.

sections.title: Build notes
sections.markdown: Maximum shield value is based on Alva's initial attack. Since Alva's personal damage potential is decent, build her like a Freeze DPS - Attack Boost, Attack, and Critical Damage/Rate. Note that Alva's Covering Mode, which should have permanent uptime, grants Alva 20% critical hit rate.
